title: Apps that help you break free from doomscrolling and get active | TechCrunch
summary: This iOS app integrates with Apple Health to limit access to designated apps until you meet your daily step goal. It recently introduced “Walking Mode,” which allows users to restrict app access until they meet specific step counts.
